gaps.explanation: Every governmental fund column of the governmental funds statement (p5) is in detail; nothing is missing and nothing is counted twice. Per fund (statement p5 vs detail): General 9,013,962 vs General Fund budget schedule (budgetary basis) Total revenues 8,949,767 (p12; p11 reconciliation: accrual adjustment for receivables 64,195); Debt Service 1,526,245 vs 1,526,245 (p5 column lines); Street 1,613,240 vs Street Fund budget schedule Total revenues 3,471,744 (p13), which includes 'Warrant income' 1,858,504 (detail index 41) that the GAAP statement does not count (p14 reconciliation: accrual adjustment for receivables (1,858,504); 3,471,744 - 1,858,504 = 1,613,240); Keno 111,681 vs Keno budget schedule 113,689 (p15; accrual adjustment for receivables (2,008)); Other Governmental Funds 201,100 vs TIF 2/4/5/7/9 lines 201,100 (p17). Gap = 64,195 - 1,858,504 - 2,008 = -1,796,317. The warrant income is a printed budget-basis actual (not the bond proceeds 7,581,439, which is a separate printed row), so it stays.

All columns present, no duplicates. Per fund (statement p5 vs detail): General 7,337,644 vs General Fund budget schedule Total expenditures 7,256,303 (p10; p11 reconciliation: accrual adjustments for payables (81,341)); Debt Service 1,062,031 vs 1,062,031 (p5 column lines); Street 6,083,588 vs Street Fund budget schedule Total expenditures 7,879,478 (p13; p14 reconciliation: accrual adjustments for payables 1,795,890; the budget schedule prints a 'Debt Service' 2,259,329 line where the statement prints Principle 21,766 / Interest 76,948); Keno 36,132 vs 36,132 (p15); Other Governmental Funds 280,209 vs TIF lines 280,209 (p17). Gap = 81,341 - 1,795,890 = -1,714,549: budgetary (cash) basis vs modified accrual, printed on both sides.

debt_proceeds 7,581,439 = Proceeds from issuance of bonds, Street Fund column (p5) = detail 'Bond proceeds' 7,581,439 (Street budget schedule p14). The schedule total 9,439,943 also counts the Street budget schedule revenue 'Warrant income' 1,858,504 (p13, detail index 41, category Debt Proceeds), which the GAAP statement does not include (p14 reconciliation reverses it as an accrual adjustment for receivables). It is a printed budget-basis line, not a duplicate of the bond proceeds; kept as printed.
